title: Stream WebRTC live delivery starts billing on 2026-10-15 after leaving beta
symptoms: Unexpected Stream charges for minutes delivered via WebRTC playback
WebRTC usage newly shown in Stream billable usage charts
cause: WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) in Stream became generally available on 2026-10-15 and usage-based billing began that day at the standard rates for minutes of video delivered. During beta it was not billed.
fix: Review Stream pricing and the new WebRTC analytics and usage charts, and cap or monitor live viewership before enabling WebRTC playback in production.
apply: Dashboard > Stream > Analytics (check WebRTC delivery minutes)
affected: Stream accounts using WebRTC live inputs, from 2026-10-15
